title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_l_arabie_saoudite_en_100_questions_by_fatiha_dazi_heni_yznj8 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_l_arabie_saoudite_en_100_questions_by_fatiha_dazi_heni_yznj8' contains malicious code.
